# usage.LlmCall

<!-- Generated by `pnpm contracts:catalog`. Do not edit. -->

A model call recorded in the usage ledger with tokens, cost and latency, per organization.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | `usage.LlmCall` |
| Kind | `view` |
| PII | `personal` |
| Tenancy scope | `organization` |
| Permission | `core.usage.read` |

## Fields

| Field | Required | PII | Description | UI |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `agentId` | yes | `none` | Agent, workflow or processor that called the model. |  |
| `cachedTokens` | yes | `none` | Prompt tokens served from the provider cache. |  |
| `costMicroUsd` | yes | `none` | Cost in micro-USD from the price table; null when the price is unknown. |  |
| `finishReason` | yes | `none` | Why generation stopped, as the provider reported it. |  |
| `id` | yes | `none` | Ledger row id (uuidv7). |  |
| `inputTokens` | yes | `none` | Prompt tokens. |  |
| `latencyMs` | yes | `none` | Wall time of the call in milliseconds. |  |
| `model` | yes | `none` | Provider model id. |  |
| `occurredAt` | yes | `none` | When the call finished (UTC). |  |
| `outputTokens` | yes | `none` | Completion tokens. |  |
| `provider` | yes | `none` | Model provider, e.g. google. |  |
| `requestId` | yes | `none` | X-Request-Id of the call that triggered the model, when known. |  |
| `tenantId` | yes | `none` | Organization billed for the call. |  |
| `traceId` | yes | `none` | W3C trace id of the run. |  |
| `userId` | yes | `personal` | Uid of the caller; null for platform jobs. |  |
